'''Thoris Darus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], holding office from [[60 BBY/Legends|60]] to [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]]. Darus was from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], and was the successor of [[Vaila Pecivas]]. During his chancellery, Darus was known as a incorrigible womanizer and enthusiast of sport, [[Opera/Legends|opera]], legitimate [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], and high cuisine. 

==Biography==
In [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], upon the request of [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ulm Brashere]], Darus appointed [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] as the [[Governor/Legends|Governor-General]] of Seswenna sector.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> He was succeeded by [[Frix]]. In later [[Standard year/Legends|years]], some citizens of the Republic would blame Darus for beginning the culture of decadence that consumed the Galactic Republic before the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWDP" />
